title: Remove Idler Pulley Assembly (A-axis / counterbalance belt system) on a LOTOed tipper
summary: LOTO the tipper, access the station side panel if needed, manually position and secure the A-axis/counterbalance using the actuator base threaded holes, remove belt clamps, release belt tension, unfasten the idler pulley assembly (M8x25 screws), and slide the idler pulley assembly out of the column. If needed, transfer the M6x35 tensioning screws to the new assembly.
when_to_use: Use when removing/replacing the tipper’s idler pulley assembly as part of a mechanical maintenance/recovery task, following the manual’s LOTO and belt-tension release precautions to prevent dropping once tension is released.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a software/controls troubleshooting guide (it is a mechanical removal procedure).
Do not proceed to release belt tension unless the A-axis/counterbalance is secured with the specified M6 socket-head screws.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform LOTO, mechanical positioning, fastener removal/installation, and belt tension release/removal steps.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before starting mechanical removal steps.
Secure the A-axis and counterbalance with M6 socket-head screws before releasing belt tension to prevent dropping.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper for LOTO and side-panel removal

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (referenced by the manual as the LOTO reference on page 2)

visual_references.description: Figure 7-21 used by the idler pulley assembly removal procedure (shows A-axis/counterbalance positioning, M6 securing screws, belt clamps, belt tensioning screws, and M8x25 mounting screws).

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is locked out/tagged out before any mechanical removal work.
steps.instruction: Apply lockout/tagout to the tipper (manual references “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is LOTOed and ready for mechanical work.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is in place before removing any side panel or fasteners.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

source_evidence.quote: 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove station side panel if necessary to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the motor area as needed for the idler pulley assembly removal.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed and the motor access area is available.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine self-tapping securing screws are removed and the side panel is off without forcing.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel is not fully secured/removed (e.g., screws left in place) or panel removal is attempted without removing the specified screws.

actions.label: Check if side panel removal is needed
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

source_evidence.quote: 2. If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

steps.title: Position A-axis and counterbalance between actuator base threaded holes
steps.purpose: Set the A-axis/counterbalance carriages to the correct location so they can be secured and will not drop when belt tension is released.
steps.instruction: Manually position the A-axis and the counterbalance between the threaded holes in the actuator base: there are two holes adjacent to each rail; position the carriages between the holes on the respective rails.
steps.expected_result: A-axis and counterbalance carriages are positioned between the threaded holes adjacent to each rail.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriages are located between the specified threaded holes on their respective rails.
steps.failure_condition: Carriages are not between the threaded holes (mispositioned), increasing risk of dropping when tension is released.

actions.label: Manually position carriages
actions.exact_action: Manually position the A-axis and the counterbalance between the threaded holes in the actuator base. There are two holes adjacent to each rail. The carriages should be positioned between the holes on the respective rails.

source_evidence.quote: 3. Manually position the A-axis and the counterbalance between the threaded holes in the actuator base. There are two holes adjacent to each rail. The carriages should be positioned between the holes on the respective rails.

steps.title: Thread M6 socket-head screws below both carriages to prevent dropping
steps.purpose: Mechanically secure the A-axis/counterbalance so it cannot drop once belt tension is released.
steps.instruction: Thread M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages.
steps.expected_result: M6 socket-head screws are threaded into the holes below both carriages, preventing drop when belt tension is released.
steps.healthy_condition: Both carriages are secured by the M6 socket-head screws below them.
steps.failure_condition: M6 socket-head screws are not installed below both carriages before belt tension is released.

actions.label: Install M6 securing screws
actions.exact_action: Thread M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages. These screws will prevent the A-Axis and counterbalance from dropping once belt tension is released.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the A-axis/counterbalance is not held securely by the threaded M6 socket-head screws before loosening belt tension (risk of dropping).

source_evidence.quote: 3. ... Thread M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages. These screws will prevent the A-Axis and counterbalance from dropping once belt tension is released.

steps.title: Remove belt clamps by removing six M6x20 countersunk screws
steps.purpose: Free the carriages from the belt so belt tension can be released and the idler pulley assembly can be removed.
steps.instruction: Remove the belt clamps by removing the six (6) M6x20 countersunk screws with a 5-mm hex wrench from each clamp to free the carriages from the belt.
steps.expected_result: Belt clamps are removed and carriages are free from the belt.
steps.healthy_condition: All six M6x20 countersunk screws per clamp are removed and the clamp(s) are off without binding the belt.
steps.failure_condition: Any clamp fasteners remain installed, preventing carriage/belt separation.

actions.label: Remove belt clamp screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the belt clamps by removing the six (6) M6x20 countersunk screws with a 5-mm hex wrench from each clamp to free the carriages from the belt.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Remove the belt clamps by removing the six (6) M6x20 countersunk screws with a 5-mm hex wrench from each clamp to free the carriages from the belt.

steps.title: Release belt tension by loosening two M6x35 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Remove tension from the belt so the idler pulley assembly can be unfastened and slid out.
steps.instruction: Release belt tension by loosening the two (2) M6x35 socket-head screws on the bottom side of the assembly.
steps.expected_result: Belt tension is released after loosening the two M6x35 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: After loosening, the belt is no longer under tension (mechanically slackened) while the A-axis/counterbalance remains secured by the M6 screws.
steps.failure_condition: Belt tension is released without the A-axis/counterbalance being secured (risk of dropping).

actions.label: Loosen tensioning screws
actions.exact_action: Release belt tension by loosening the two (2) M6x35 socket-head screws on the bottom side of the assembly.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the A-axis/counterbalance is not held securely by the threaded M6 socket-head screws before loosening belt tension (risk of dropping).

source_evidence.quote: 5. Release belt tension by loosening the two (2) M6x35 socket-head screws on the bottom side of the assembly.

steps.title: Remove idler pulley assembly and slide it out of the column
steps.purpose: Unfasten the idler pulley assembly and remove it from the tipper column for replacement.
steps.instruction: Remove the two (2) M8x25 socket-head screws holding the idler pulley assembly in place, then slide the idler pulley assembly out of the column. If needed, transfer the M6x35 tensioning screws from the removed idler pulley assembly to the new assembly.
steps.expected_result: The two M8x25 screws are removed and the idler pulley assembly slides out of the column; if required, M6x35 tensioning screws are transferred to the new assembly.
steps.healthy_condition: Idler pulley assembly is fully removed with no remaining fasteners; tensioning screws are available on the new assembly if the manual note applies.
steps.failure_condition: Idler pulley assembly does not slide out after removing the two M8x25 socket-head screws (possible remaining fasteners or misalignment).

actions.label: Remove mounting screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the two (2) M8x25 socket-head screws holding the idler pulley assembly in place

actions.label: Slide assembly out
actions.exact_action: then slide the idler pulley assembly out of the column.

actions.label: Transfer tensioning screws if needed
actions.exact_action: NOTE: Transfer the M6x35 tensioning screws from the removed idler pulley assembly to the new assembly if needed.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the idler pulley assembly does not slide out after removing the two M8x25 socket-head screws (possible remaining fasteners or misalignment).

source_evidence.quote: 6. Remove the two (2) M8x25 socket-head screws holding the idler pulley assembly in place and slide the idler pulley assembly out of the column. NOTE: Transfer the M6x35 tensioning screws from the removed idler pulley assembly to the new assembly if needed.

success_criteria: Tipper remains LOTOed throughout the mechanical removal steps.
A-axis and counterbalance are secured with M6 socket-head screws before belt tension is released.
Belt clamps are removed (six M6x20 countersunk screws per clamp) and belt tension is released (two M6x35 socket-head screws loosened).
Idler pulley assembly is unfastened (two M8x25 socket-head screws removed) and slid out of the column.
If required, M6x35 tensioning screws are transferred to the new idler pulley assembly.
healthy_conditions: Carriages are positioned between the actuator base threaded holes adjacent to each rail.
M6 socket-head screws are installed below both carriages.
Belt clamps are removed and belt tension is released without the A-axis/counterbalance dropping.
Idler pulley assembly slides out after removing the two M8x25 screws.
failure_conditions: A-axis/counterbalance is not held securely by the threaded M6 socket-head screws before loosening belt tension.
Idler pulley assembly does not slide out after removing the two M8x25 socket-head screws.
escalation_guidance: If the A-axis/counterbalance is not secured before belt tension release, stop and escalate due to risk of dropping.
If the idler pulley assembly does not slide out after removing the two M8x25 screws, stop and escalate for inspection of remaining fasteners or misalignment.
